subject: Source-only F-91 Patreon mobile parity implementation
body:
FT-HERMES/1 TYPE: TASK
WIRE: CODEX-F91-MOBILE-PATREON-R1
SEQ: 1
STATE: ASSIGNED
NEXT_OWNER: HERMES
SOURCE_REF: 0ad5c11a8e3f872a7bacfdacae08fce0bb9a5fa6
COPY_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/work/codex-f91-mobile-parity-r1
LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE
DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer, deployment, live database, migrations, provider credentials, OAuth secrets, permissions, systemd, network, external Patreon calls, commit, push

MISSION
Implement the missing native-mobile source slice for the already-integrated F-91 Patreon community contract. This is a real implementation task, not a plan, baseline copy, pure contract, or ACK-only task. Work only in COPY_ROOT from the exact SOURCE_REF. Codex retains audit, integration, commit and push ownership.

PASS CRITERIA
1. Read the exact current mobile architecture, existing authenticated API client, Patreon dashboard/API contracts, role gates, and current tests before editing. Do not invent a second provider contract or expose Patreon capabilities the backend marks unsupported.
2. Add a reachable native-mobile model-selection and Patreon community surface using the existing authenticated BFF/session pattern. It must list only models the signed-in user may see, handle zero models and unavailable data honestly, and never accept an arbitrary model id without the same server authorization.
3. For a selected model, expose the existing Patreon connection state, connect handoff, status/counts, campaign/member/post read views, manual sync controls, sync progress/error/empty states, and the existing manual-assist boundary. The connect action may hand off to the existing backend browser OAuth route; the mobile client must not hold Patreon client secrets or tokens.
4. Preserve the existing capability boundary: no Patreon publish, DM, payout, member mutation, email/address scope, unsupported analytics, or direct provider call from mobile. Roles unable to connect or sync see explanation-only UI; forbidden controls are absent or disabled consistently with the backend.
5. Use bounded rendering for provider records and safe redacted summaries; do not render access tokens, raw provider payloads, webhook signatures, internal errors, or unbounded arrays. Keep all mutations idempotent/retry-safe using the existing client conventions.
6. Add behavior-level mobile tests covering model scoping/empty state, connected and disconnected Patreon states, sync success/error/retry, role-restricted controls, loading states, and the forbidden-capability copy. Update endpoint/client tests where needed.
7. Run the owning mobile test suite, mobile typecheck, and mobile web export/build if the repository supports it. Record exact commands, exit codes, changed paths, per-file SHA256 values, and the exact source HEAD used.

DELIVERY RULE
Return exactly one evidence-bearing PROGRESS after implementation begins, then one signed DELIVERY with changed paths, per-file SHA256, exact commands and exit codes, behavior-test counts, and LIVE_ACTIONS NONE; or return one terminal BLOCKED with the exact missing capability. ACK/READ is ownership only and is not delivery. Do not use wall-clock or filesystem dates for coordination; use WIRE, SEQ and state. Every reply must end exactly with:
sincerely, Codex
